captions.help.slots.dragonscode.multiplier.reel.d: Dragon's Code" is an enchanting 50-payline slot that invites players into a mystical world inspired by the majesty of elves. The game offers a thrilling Re-spin bonus feature, as well as a Re-spin Buy option for those seeking extra chances to win. With captivating graphics and immersive gameplay, this slot brings the allure of the elven realm to life

Before each spin, a random multiplier (ranging from 1X to 5X) is chosen on an extra multiplier reel. Any wins during the spin, as well as wins from bonus re-spins, will be boosted by this selected multiplier, enhancing the excitement and potential rewards.

The Bonus Re-spin feature in Dragon's Code gives players a chance to collect selected symbols during re-spins for bigger wins. The feature ends when no additional re-spin symbols appear, and winnings are calculated at the end. Here are the ways to activate it:
For 40X the bet size, players can buy a re-spin featuring one of the top 4 symbols.
This option allows players to buy a re-spin with a randomly selected symbol for 25X the bet size.

After a base game spin, a Golden Egg symbol can randomly trigger the feature by breaking the dragon's nest, filling the 1st reel with dragon symbols, which transform into matching symbols to start the re-spin.
During the base game, if 4 matching symbols land on reel 1 and a Wild symbol appears on any other reel, the re-spin feature starts (excluding full-screen wins).
captions.help.slots.dragonscode.double.gamble.des: Players have the opportunity to double their winnings with the X2 Gamble feature. After a winning spin, players can access the Gamble round by clicking the “x2” button. Once the gamble screen appears, a card in the middle of the screen will flash red and black while face down, indicating that the gamble feature is active. To double their winnings, players must correctly guess the color of the card that will be revealed next. If they succeed, their winnings will be doubled. However, if they guess incorrectly, their original win will be lost. At any point, players can use the “Take Win” button to collect their winnings and add them to their main balance.
captions.help.slots.dragonscode.payline.headline: PAYLINES AND RULES
captions.help.slots.dragonscode.payline.descripti: Winning combinations form by landing matching symbols on adjacent reels, following selected paylines from left to right, starting from the leftmost reel. Scatter wins are combined with payline wins, and only the highest payline and/or scatter wins are awarded. Line/Scatter wins are multiplied by the bet value on the winning line, along with the value from the Multiplier reel.
captions.help.slots.dragonscode.buttons.2x.choose: open the menu, and choose your bet.
captions.help.slots.dragonscode.other.rules.descr:
Disconnection: In the event of a disconnection during gameplay, all accepted bets will still be played out, and any resulting wins will be credited to the player’s balance at the end of the round. Please note that after a disconnection, autoplay mode will be switched off to ensure a fair and enjoyable gaming experience. It’s important to note that any malfunction will void all plays and payouts, and any unfinished round will be terminated.

When you hit the winning combination, you have three options to credit the win amount to your balance: you can start a new spin by clicking the spin button, use the take win button to transfer the win to your balance, or use the X2 double up feature button and click take win. If you are playing in autoplay mode, all wins are automatically transferred to your balance.
